title: 1 Chronicles 26
paragraphs: ¹ These were the divisions of the gatekeepers: From the Korahites, Meshelemiah son of Kore, one of the sons of Asaph. ² Meshelemiah's sons: Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth, ³ Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh. ⁴ Obed-edom's sons: Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, Nethaneel the fifth, ⁵ Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth — for God had blessed Obed-edom.

⁶ Obed-edom's son Shemaiah also had sons who were leaders in their father's family, for they were men of great ability. ⁷ The sons of Shemaiah: Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad — along with their brothers Elihu and Semachiah, who were capable men. ⁸ All of these were descendants of Obed-edom — they and their sons and brothers, sixty-two capable and strong men in the service. ⁹ Meshelemiah also had sons and brothers — eighteen capable men in all. ¹⁰ Hosah of the Merarites also had sons: Simri was the chief, although he was not the firstborn, his father had appointed him chief.

¹¹ Hilkiah was the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth. All the sons and brothers of Hosah numbered thirteen. ¹² These divisions of gatekeepers, through their leaders, had assignments for service in the house of the LORD, just as their kinsmen did. ¹³ They cast lots by family for each gate, young and old alike. ¹⁴ The lot for the East Gate fell to Shelemiah. Then lots were cast for his son Zechariah, a wise counselor, and his lot came out for the North Gate. ¹⁵ The lot for Obed-edom fell to the South Gate, and to his sons fell the storehouse.

¹⁶ Shuppim and Hosah drew the West Gate along with the Shallecheth Gate on the upper road — guard station against guard station. ¹⁷ There were six Levites stationed each day at the east side, four at the north, four at the south, and two at a time at the storehouse. ¹⁸ At the court on the west side there were four at the road and two at the court itself. ¹⁹ These were the divisions of the gatekeepers among the Korahites and Merarites. ²⁰ Ahijah, a fellow Levite, was in charge of the treasuries of the house of God and the treasuries of the dedicated gifts.

²¹ Among the sons of Laadan the Gershonite — the family heads of Laadan the Gershonite — Jehieli was chief. ²² The sons of Jehieli, Zetham and his brother Joel, were in charge of the treasuries of the house of the LORD. ²³ From among the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites: ²⁴ Shebuel son of Gershom, son of Moses, was chief officer in charge of the treasuries. ²⁵ Through his kinsman Eliezer came Rehabiah his son, then Jeshaiah his son, Joram his son, Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.

²⁶ This Shelomith and his brothers had charge of all the treasuries of the dedicated things — those which King David, the family heads, the commanders of thousands and hundreds, and the army commanders had dedicated. ²⁷ They had dedicated part of the plunder from their campaigns to maintain the house of the LORD. ²⁸ Everything that Samuel the seer, Saul son of Kish, Abner son of Ner, and Joab son of Zeruiah had dedicated — along with anything dedicated by anyone else — was under the care of Shelomith and his brothers. ²⁹ From the Izharites: Chenaniah and his sons handled the administrative work outside the sanctuary as officers and judges over Israel. ³⁰ From the Hebronites: Hashabiah and his kinsmen, seventeen hundred capable men, were officials over Israel west of the Jordan in everything pertaining to the LORD and the king's service.

³¹ Among the Hebronites, Jerijah was the chief, according to the genealogical records of his family. In the fortieth year of David's reign, a search was made and capable men were found among them at Jazer in Gilead. ³² His kinsmen were twenty-seven hundred capable men, heads of families, and King David put them in charge of the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half-tribe of Manasseh in every matter concerning God and the king.
